note: getProcessor reads only the test field testMode, an enum (LocaleDataPassesTest$TestMode) declared in the test class itself. Rule 6 keeps that class off the replay classpath, so classMap maps it to the helper's verbatim copy (LocaleDataPassesTest_Helpers$TestMode), and the recorded testFields.testMode is decoded onto the helper's testMode field. The verbatim switch then picks the pass: PROTECT_DATA runs new ProtectGoogLocale(compiler); REPLACE_PROTECTED_DATA runs ProtectGoogLocale and then new LocaleDataPasses.LocaleSubstitutions(compiler, compiler.getOptions().getLocale()). The two records cover both constants. getProcessor does not read the test field locale: the overridden getOptions() copies it into options.setLocale, which is replayed from the record's options diff (options.locale = en / es_ES). setUp's enableRewriteClosureCode/enableRewriteClosureProvides/enableClosurePassForExpected/enableNormalize and multiTest's allowExternsChanges are in harness.fields.
